text:
sam-support: Heads-up — right after the 22:00 canary deploy that enabled auth-header rotation we started getting a stream of 5xx/ISEs for hosted-inference requests. Support queue has ~30 unique customer errors so far. Can we triage? :rotating_light:

jess-prodeng: Thanks, looking. Which flag and rollout %?

sam-support: flag is `enable_auth_header_rotation` rolled to 10% via canary at 22:00. Traffic skewed to canary pods via routing policy. Logs trending up around 22:05.

maria-sre: I'm seeing gateway 502/503 spikes from the ingress shedder — but also a bunch of 500s from the inference gateway  (model-proxy). Dumping sample errors now.

raj-backend: quick context: the rotation changes the canonical auth header from `Authorization` to `X-Auth-Claims` for internal clients, with a fallback. I added a stricter parser to fail fast for malformed headers. Could that be blowing up on older SDKs that only send `Authorization`?

lee-frontend: customer repro — curl against /v1/generate returns 503 for some accounts, 200 for others. Repro snippet: ```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer abc" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate
```
Response: 503 Service Unavailable (no body).

aaron-plat: Can you paste a model-proxy log for one of the 500s? Need stack trace.

maria-sre: paste: ```
2025-06-14T22:05:12Z model-proxy[pod-73] ERROR request_id=abc123 handler=auth middleware panic: runtime error: invalid memory address
stack: goroutine 52 [running]:
main.middleware.auth(0xc000...)
\t/go/src/redwood/model-proxy/auth.go:87 +0x1b3
...
```

jess-prodeng: That looks like a nil deref in the new parser. Raj — line 87 is inside RotateAndParse(). If the fallback header isn't present we should not panic.

raj-backend: ugh. I missed a nil check in the code path that assumes `X-Auth-Claims` exists when rotation is enabled. We need immediate rollback of the flag.

sam-support: Customers hitting billing endpoints are reporting failed charges — some webhooks retrying; support is fielding escalations with exec priority. Can we disable the flag ASAP? @aaron-plat can you coordinate?

aaron-plat: On it. I'm toggling the feature flag back to 0% on prod. Command: ```bash
redwoodctl feature set enable_auth_header_rotation --env=prod --pct=0 --who=aaron --reason="rollback nil-deref"
```
Doing now.

inc-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-3475 — "canary auth header rotation caused 5xx spike" (severity: high). Paging oncall.

maria-sre: After flag toggle we see errors decline in ~30s. Metrics show 90% drop in 5xx against the affected route.

lee-frontend: Confirmed customer requests returning 200 again. Support updating ticket queue. :white_check_mark:

jess-prodeng: Next steps: patch in repo to add nil checks and fallbacks, add unit tests for missing headers, and add a canary gating check (verify requests/success ratio before increasing pct). Also we should improve the rollback runbook to include immediate load-shed fallback.

raj-backend: I have a quick fix branch: `fix/auth-rotation-nilcheck`. Patch adds: ```go
if header == nil {
  // preserve old behaviour
  header = r.Header.Get("Authorization")
}
```
Will push PR and request urgent review.

aaron-plat: Filing a canary postmortem checklist item — we increased to 10% without the new health-check that verifies absence of 5xx on a synthetic set. Let's not increase rollout % until the test is green.

sam-support: Support notes: created templated customer message explaining transient errors and rollback, offered priority support for affected accounts. Sent to legal for billing hold guidance.

maria-sre: Telemetry follow-ups: add a canary-specific alert that triggers on 5xx rate > 1% above baseline within 5m of a flag change. Also log the feature flag id in request traces so we can slice faster.

jess-prodeng: Agreed. Also adding a preflight script to the rollout pipeline that runs a small batch of real-ish requests against canary pods and checks 200 rate > 99%.

raj-backend: PR up, tagging @jess-prodeng for quick review. Patch includes tests and a non-breaking default behaviour.

aaron-plat: Rolling patch to canary environment first, will run canary-gen tests, then coordinate safe gradual rollout when green.

lee-frontend: Notes for support: customers to refund? ops/legal decision pending. For now we queued affected billing events for manual retry.

sam-support: Thanks everyone for fast action. Action items summary (assign owners):
- raj-backend: merge fix + tests (ETA 1h)
- jess-prodeng: add canary preflight to pipeline (ETA 2d)
- maria-sre: create canary 5xx alert & add flag id in traces (ETA 1d)
- aaron-plat: update rollback runbook to include feature toggle + routing fallback (ETA 1d)
- sam-support: customer comms + billing triage (ongoing)

inc-bot: Incident INC-2025-3475 marked as mitigated at 2025-06-14T22:12:34Z by feature toggle rollback.

jess-prodeng: We'll schedule a postmortem meeting tomorrow. Please add any additional notes to the incident doc.

sam-support: Closing thread here — re-open if we see any regression. Thanks :heart:
